about: The founder has worked as a software development contractor during the majority of his career and while the compensation was above average, the projects and duration were unpredictable. Coupled with the founders successful background in currency trading provide employee leasing at a fraction of the cost to employers while offering prevailing wages with full benefits to the employees. The employers receive happier staff which translate to increase productivity and sales. The employees received consistent prevailing market wages with benefits that are not contingent on their employers profits.
